editorial:
Imagine moving back to the town where your worst nightmare happened just to get a paycheck. That is exactly what Jim Norman does when he takes a teaching job in his old hometown. Twenty-seven years ago, Jim watched some mean teenagers kill his brother, and that trauma still follows him. The movie starts off like a slow drama, but it quickly turns into a creepy puzzle. You will feel Jim's stress as he realizes the students in his classroom are starting to look exactly like the bullies from his past. It is a weird, spooky setup that makes you wonder if he is losing his mind or if something supernatural is actually happening.

The acting is solid and the mystery keeps you guessing until the end. While some of the special effects feel a bit dated since it was a TV movie, the tension makes up for it. If you like stories about revenge and creepy kids, you should definitely give this one a shot.
endingExplained: You find out that the bullies are actually coming back from the dead to torture Jim. They use a supernatural power to take over the bodies of current students. In the end, Jim has to face his fear and fight back against the leader of the group. He eventually manages to stop the cycle of violence and put the spirits to rest, finally finding some peace for his brother and himself.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s supernatural thrillers and creepy school settings.
